operations.summary: Create a draft from trusted server-resolved evidence
operations.description: Requires identity_verification.self.manage. The evidence token must be bound by the resolver to the authenticated tenant and user. A missing resolver fails service construction; client-supplied fingerprint or material metadata is rejected as an unknown field. Live IAM is checked without business writes before reserving evidence, then checked again inside the create transaction before idempotency, locks, DML, or audit.

operations.summary: Read the authenticated user's own verification status
operations.description: Read-only profile badge source for the authenticated tenant user. An approved initial personal identity keeps status verified; otherwise a submitted or reviewing latest case is pending, a rejected latest case is rejected, and no case, draft, withdrawn, or expired is unverified. The response never carries a document number, name, organization, fingerprint, material, or reviewer identity. Requires the same live identity_verification.self.manage check as reading an owned case.

responses.description: The authenticated user's own verification status.

fields.description: Approval time of the initial personal identity; present only when verified by it.
